parameters: test value: inlet pressure when run alone (fed by the parent vessel in a network); needs the proposed config fix
test value: constant observed pressure (fed by a pressure_observer in a network); needs the proposed config fix
test value: constant observed flow (fed by a flow_observer in a network); needs the proposed config fix

invariants.description: R_T follows the CellML piecewise law: 1 Pa s m^-3 if check <= 0, check if 0 < check <= 1e13, 1e13 above (NB values in (0, 1) pass through unclamped)
physical bound: terminal flows stay below 1e-3 m3/s (60 L/min, far above any single terminal) - fails when the learned output goes negative and R_T drops to the 1 Pa s m^-3 floor
the three membership functions (negative / zero / positive pressure error) form a partition of unity: u2 + u5 + u8 = 1
constant observed pressure => constant error, so d(aa_i)/dt = error d(cc_i)/dt gives the first integral aa_i - 100 = error (cc_i - 100) (both start at 100), i = 2, 5, 8
invariants.expr: (np.max(np.abs((aa2 - 100) - error*(cc2 - 100))) <= 1e-6*max(1.0, np.max(np.abs(aa2 - 100)))) & (np.max(np.abs((aa5 - 100) - error*(cc5 - 100))) <= 1e-6*max(1.0, np.max(np.abs(aa5 - 100)))) & (np.max(np.abs((aa8 - 100) - error*(cc8 - 100))) <= 1e-6*max(1.0, np.max(np.abs(aa8 - 100))))

invariants.description: pressure error is pressure_d - u_a with the harness value u_a = 12000.0 Pa
flow-fraction error: error_flow_percent = 100 (BFF_ASL - v_a/meanflow_4dflow), harness v_a = 1e-06 m3/s
volume balance: q_T(t) - q_T(t0) = integral of (v - v_T) dt from t0 = 10 ms (after the sub-ms inertial start-up), trapezoid on the output grid
pressure law: u_C = q_T/C_T and u = u_C + (0.01/C_T)(v - v_T)

bc_sweep.rationale: C_T spans two decades around the ADAN-derived cerebral terminal value 2.6e-13 m3/Pa; BFF_ASL spans 2-50 % flow fractions (the cerebral_elic values are 9-31 %); pressure_d spans 60-120 mmHg (the library nominal 520346 Pa is questioned in the review); meanflow spans a single cerebral territory (~1e-6) to the current library value 3e-4 m3/s.

baseline.reason: adaptive controller acting as a boundary condition; its targets (pressure_d, BFF_ASL, meanflow_4dflow) are patient inputs. Validation belongs to the closed-loop cerebral network (e.g. achieved territory flow fractions vs ASL), not to the terminal alone

calibrate.note: not_applicable: the controller identifies R_T online; nothing to calibrate in isolation
